latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of CloudMigrate skill for automated cloud migration and IaC workflows.

- Automates multi-cloud migrations and infrastructure deployment across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
- Generates Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, Ansible) from natural language requirements.
- Provides migration strategy planning, cost analysis, risk mitigation, and rollback procedures.
- Supports complex use cases: lift-and-shift, CI/CD pipelines, disaster recovery, Kubernetes automation, and more.
- Integrates with Slack and GitHub for collaboration and GitOps workflows.
